name: Dylan Tan
tagline: Product, furniture and generative form. From first sketch to the factory floor.
about:
I'm an industrial designer working across product, furniture and visualization. My first project shipped when I was 16: a reduced-chamber atomizer I designed with the team at Captivape and had manufactured in the USA.

I studied industrial design at the University of Tennessee, in a program led by Herman Miller designers. Since then I've taken products at Motech from ideation through manufacturing and sale, using generative CAD, fabrication and a lot of prototyping to solve problems like lightweight resin waterfall countertops.

Outside client work I explore form through RenderWeekly challenges, sculpture and AI-assisted concept work.
capabilities:
Product design
Furniture design
Generative CAD (Rhino + Grasshopper)
Solidworks
Blender rendering
Prototyping and fabrication
Packaging and market research
AI-assisted concept development
